# Auth layout: `jl-auth-layout`

The sign-in screen every SyWare app shares: the brand on a dark panel, the form beside it.

- Class `JlAuthLayout`, a template: `import { JlAuthLayout } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/auth-layout

The sign-in screen every SyWare app shares. On the left, a dark panel: the app's brand (slot brand,
its icon and wordmark), a headline whose words between asterisks take the brand's blue, a sentence, three points and
where the app comes from, with the SyWare mark large and faint in the corner. On the right, the form: the default
slot, centred.

The panel stays dark in both themes: it takes jlib's dark tokens itself, so what is slotted in it reads light on
dark. On a phone it shrinks to a band with the brand, above the form. Use it for signing in, choosing a first
password, or anything else before the app opens. See the Accounts and settings pattern.

## Use

```ts
import { JlAppIcon, JlAuthLayout, JlButton } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlAuthLayout
  origin="Made in Switzerland by SyWare"
  pitch="Order like a shop. *Pick with your phone.*"
  points={["Order in a few taps, always for a job number","Pick with your phone, with barcodes or without"]}
  text="Employees order what their job needs, logistics prepares it, and the stock stays right."
>
  <span slot="brand" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px">
    <JlAppIcon icon="package" /><span>sw<span style="color: var(--jl-brand)">stock</span></span>
  </span>
  <JlButton variant="primary" label="Sign in" />
</JlAuthLayout>
```

```html
<jl-auth-layout
  origin="Made in Switzerland by SyWare"
  pitch="Order like a shop. *Pick with your phone.*"
  points='["Order in a few taps, always for a job number","Pick with your phone, with barcodes or without"]'
  style="--min-height: 480px"
  text="Employees order what their job needs, logistics prepares it, and the stock stays right."
>
  <span slot="brand" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px">
    <jl-app-icon icon="package"></jl-app-icon><span>sw<span style="color: var(--jl-brand)">stock</span></span>
  </span>
  <jl-button variant="primary" label="Sign in"></jl-button>
</jl-auth-layout>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `pitch` (attribute `pitch`): `string`, default `''`. What the app does, in a few words; *words* between asterisks take the brand's blue.
- `text` (attribute `text`): `string`, default `''`. One or two sentences under the headline.
- `points` (attribute `points`): `string[]`, default `[]`. What the app is good at, three at most.
- `origin` (attribute `origin`): `string | null`, default `null`. Where the app comes from, at the foot of the panel: jlib's own text, in the language shown, when not set; empty shows nothing.

## Slots

- The default slot: The form, centred beside the panel.
- `brand`: The app's brand: its icon and wordmark.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The grid of the panel and the form.
- `story` (part, `::part(story)`): The dark panel.
- `side` (part, `::part(side)`): The side that holds the form.
- `--min-height` (custom property): Its least height: the whole screen (100dvh).

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Signing in

```html
<div style="overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg)">
  <jl-auth-layout style="--min-height: 560px" pitch="Workflows that *ask* before they act." text="Automate the repetitive work. Whenever a decision matters, the workflow pauses and a person approves, corrects or rejects it." points='["Build workflows from steps, without code","Review what the workflow proposes, with everything it read","Every decision is kept: who, when, what changed, and why"]'>
    <span slot="brand" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.02em">
    <jl-app-icon icon="workflow"></jl-app-icon>
    <span>sw<span style="color: var(--jl-brand)">ai</span></span>
  </span>
    <div style="display: grid; gap: 16px; width: min(360px, 100%)">
    <div style="display: grid; gap: 4px">
      <strong style="font-size: 22px">Sign in</strong>
      <span class="muted">Use the account your administrator gave you.</span>
    </div>
    <jl-field label="Username"><jl-input autocomplete="username"></jl-input></jl-field>
    <jl-field label="Password"><jl-input type="password" autocomplete="current-password"></jl-input></jl-field>
    <jl-button variant="primary" label="Sign in" block></jl-button>
  </div>
  </jl-auth-layout>
</div>
```
